text: {"reply": "I'm sorry your vehicle is disabled. First, please keep the driver safe: if the vehicle is on the shoulder, stay inside with your seatbelt on and hazard lights on, or get out and move well away from the traffic, behind the guardrail if there is one. Call 911 right away if anyone is hurt or in danger. Please don't drive the vehicle until it has been checked. I also need to correct my earlier message: I can't confirm that a tow has been dispatched or give an ETA, because I don't have dispatch access.
